answer: Make eligibility depend on a slow river of attestations: each member must collect fresh endorsements from several distinct, long-standing members every epoch, and endorsers lose standing if their vouchee is exposed as fake. A mirror check compares endorsement patterns against the network average, so a zephyr of cheap self-referential fake clusters stands out at once. A sybil farmer must win over many independent real members per fake, and each fake risks burning its endorsers, so the cost per fake keeps rising while the reward stays flat.
